Priya Rao: Quick thread — Veridian wants to shorten renewal to 9 months and request proration on the final invoice. Can we coordinate amendment + procurement?
Marco Diaz: Procurement note: need vendor code before finalizing PO. PO number we got is PO-88219 but vendor code missing.
Evelyn Chen: I can draft a one-page amendment and SOW patch. Will include proration calc and Net60 per customer ask.
Samir Patel: Onboarding flagged billing-entity mismatch; Legal will need to confirm signatory authority if entity changes. @LegalBot please advise.
LegalBot: Policy: term reductions require an exec-signed amendment + updated SOW with explicit billing-entity confirmation.
Priya Rao: Finance example calc to include: Annual $120,000 -> 9/12 = $90,000; prorate credit $30,000 applied to final invoice.
Marco Diaz: I can request procurement exception from Maya if vendor code not available immediately.
Maya (Procurement): Exception ok for 3 business days; vendor code must be posted or exception revoked.
Evelyn Chen: Draft uploaded to drive: https://redwood.app/drafts/veridian-9mo-amend-5102023456. Will create Docusign envelope when ready. ETA ~2h.
Priya Rao: Capture reason in account health: "budget timing shift" and add enablement note for shortened onboarding cadence.
Samir Patel: I'll loop billing for rev-rec and collections implications.
Marco Diaz: Procurement will add vendor code tomorrow morning per Maya.
Evelyn Chen: Docusign sent: https://docusign.example/envelope/5102023456
Priya Rao: Status: awaiting vendor code + signature. Will escalate to sales if no movement by EOD. :thumbsup:
